name: nextjs
description: Official Next.js agent skills for Cache Components, Partial Prefetching, bundle audits, and runtime verification.

interface.shortDescription: Adopt and optimize Cache Components, Partial Prefetching, and Next.js runtime behavior
interface.longDescription:
Official Next.js agent skills that ship in the vercel/next.js repository. They teach coding agents how to adopt and optimize Cache Components and Partial Prefetching, audit browser bundles with next analyze, and verify runtime behavior against a running next dev server.

Use them when enabling cacheComponents or partialPrefetching, fixing blocking-prerender and instant-navigation insights, growing a route's static shell, deciding what selected navigations should prefetch, reducing oversized client bundles, or confirming a change works at runtime with /_next/mcp and agent-browser — not just that it compiles.

The skill text is the same guidance already maintained under skills/ in this repository.
defaultPrompt: Adopt Cache Components and fix the blocking routes the build reports
Enable Partial Prefetching and preserve our existing prefetched UI with instant() tests
Audit this app's client bundles and report oversized dependencies
